Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Grand Isle Swivel Rocker Dining Chair, Set of 2
Materials: Aluminum
Set of 2 swiveling rockers for outdoor use; removable seat cushions secured to frame via straps Durable yet lightweight cast aluminum with black powder-coat finish; cushions are polypropylene canvas filled with 50/50 polyester/PU foam Use alone or as part of a fully matching outdoor furniture collection Cushions measure 20.8 by 22 by 2.5 inches Each chair measures 36 inches high by 24.8 inches deep by 22.8 inches wide and weighs 25 pounds; some assembly required
